title: Secure your app: mitigate risks to agentic features
description: Explore how to evaluate threats from indirect prompt injection, such as data exfiltration and unintended actions. Discover system safeguards and security best practices for using App Intents and the Foundation Models framework, including mitigations such as user confirmations, secure prompt design, and authentication.
